title: Pipeline
summary: Fixed dependent stages run in order.
useWhen: Later work needs an earlier result.
Stage boundaries provide useful gates or reuse.
avoidWhen: One agent already holds the whole task and scripting adds no value.
contract: Stop dependent stages when a required gate fails.
Use adversarial verification when a gate must be independently checked; otherwise outputs remain claims.
example: Inspect a migration, propose a change, then review the proposal in separate dependent stages.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Inspect] --> G[Gate]
  G --> B[Propose]
  B --> H[Gate]
  H --> C[Review]
